title: Pure Fusion
summary: A dedicated pure Fusion strategy built around generic Fusion Substitute monsters, Polymerization, and Fusion Normal Spells. By pairing substitutes like King of the Swamp and Versago the Destroyer with Keeper of Dragon Magic and Duality, the deck cheats out iconic Fusion bosses without running their bricky Normal Monster materials.

summary.title: Starters
points: Keeper of Dragon Magic discards a card on Normal or Special Summon to search Polymerization, Greater Polymerization, or Magicalized Fusion, and acts as the Dragon Effect Monster material for Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon.
King of the Swamp discards itself from the hand to search Polymerization, or acts in the hand, field, or GY as a substitute for any named Fusion Material such as Dark Magician or Relinquished.
Fusion Recycling Plant (and Terraforming) discards a card once per turn to add Polymerization from the Deck or GY, then recovers a Fusion Material used that turn during the End Phase.

summary.title: Opening: Keeper of Dragon Magic + Any Discard
steps: Normal Summon Keeper of Dragon Magic and discard Performage Trick Clown (or a Fusion Substitute) to search Polymerization.
If Trick Clown was discarded, Special Summon it back; reveal a Fusion Monster in the Extra Deck with Keeper to revive a Fusion Substitute from the GY in face-down Defense Position.
Activate Polymerization using the Fusion Substitute (substituting for Dark Magician) and Keeper of Dragon Magic (a Dragon Effect Monster) to Fusion Summon Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon.
In the End Phase, if Fusion Recycling Plant is active, return the Fusion Substitute from the GY to the hand to pay for Dragoon's omni-negate on the opponent's turn.

summary.title: Fusion Substitutes & Duality
summary.text: King of the Swamp, Beastking of the Swamps, Versago the Destroyer, and Fusion Parasite substitute for any 1 named Fusion Material on a Fusion Monster, unlocking Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon and Millennium-Eyes Restrict. When Special Summoned (including face-up after flipping or revival), Fusion Parasite immediately performs a Fusion Summon without a Spell. Duality tributes a LIGHT or DARK monster to cheat out an Extra Deck counterpart with the same Type and Level but opposite Attribute: tributing Level 1 LIGHT Spellcaster Effect Veiler summons Level 1 DARK Spellcaster Millennium-Eyes Restrict, and tributing Level 8 DARK Dragon Starving Venom Fusion Dragon summons Level 8 LIGHT/DARK Spellcaster/Dragon bosses.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon cannot be targeted or destroyed by card effects, destroys monsters up to the Normal Monsters used (or burns via its effect), and discards 1 card to negate and destroy any activation while permanently gaining 1000 ATK.

Guardian Chimera, summoned via Polymerization or Greater Polymerization, draws cards equal to materials used from the hand, destroys cards equal to materials used from the field, and is untargetable while Polymerization is in the GY.
Magnum the Reliever shuffles a Polymerization or Fusion Spell from the GY into the Deck to draw a card, and banishes one from the GY as a Quick Effect to destroy a card on the field.
Millennium-Eyes Restrict equips an opponent's monster when it activates an effect, negating all monsters with that name.

summary.title: Spells
points: Super Polymerization fuses away opposing monsters into Mudragon of the Swamp, Garura, Wings of Resonant Life, Starving Venom Fusion Dragon, or Earth Golem @Ignister without allowing either player to respond.
Greater Polymerization fuses 3 or more monsters into an effect-indestructible Guardian Chimera with piercing battle damage.

Magicalized Fusion banishes materials from your field or GY (including Fusion Substitutes) to summon Spellcaster Fusions like Millennium-Eyes Restrict, Mysterion the Dragon Crown, or Magnum the Reliever.

allow.Performage Trick Clown: LIGHT Spellcaster that revives itself when sent to the GY as Fusion Material; primes Duality targets and triggers Cross-Sheep.
allow.Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon: Fusion boss summoned using a Fusion Substitute monster (King of the Swamp/Versago/Parasite) + a Dragon Effect monster (Keeper of Dragon Magic/Trishula); provides omni-negation, non-targeting destruction, and burn.
allow.Millennium-Eyes Restrict: Fusion boss summoned using a Fusion Substitute + 1 Effect Monster (or Duality); absorbs opposing monsters when they activate effects.
allow.Guardian Chimera: Level 9 Fusion boss summoned using Polymerization or Greater Polymerization that draws cards, destroys cards, and cannot be targeted while Polymerization is in the GY.
allow.Earth Golem @Ignister: Super Polymerization target made with 1 Cyberse monster + 1 Link Monster; punishes Link decks.
allow.Trishula, the Dragon of Icy Imprisonment: Fusion boss summoned by banishing 3 monsters with different names from field or hand; Dragon material for Dragoon.

main: Keeper of Dragon Magic

Core starter: discards 1 card on Normal or Special Summon to add ANY 'Polymerization' Normal Spell or 'Fusion' Normal Spell from Deck to hand; reveals a Fusion Monster to revive a material face-down; and acts as a Dragon Effect Monster for Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon!
King of the Swamp

The premier Fusion substitute: substitutes for ANY 1 named Fusion Material on a Fusion Monster (Dark Magician for Dragoon, Relinquished for Millennium-Eyes!), OR discards itself from hand to add Polymerization from Deck to hand.
Beastking of the Swamps
WATER Aqua Fusion Substitute monster that substitutes for any 1 named Fusion Material on a Fusion Monster Card.
Versago the Destroyer
DARK Fiend Fusion Substitute monster that substitutes for any 1 named Fusion Material; prime DARK tribute for Duality and material for Starving Venom.
Fusion Parasite
DARK Insect Fusion Substitute monster: when Special Summoned, immediately performs a Fusion Summon using monsters you control including itself without needing a Fusion Spell!
Performage Trick Clown

LIGHT Spellcaster Level 4: when sent to the GY (by Fusion Summon, Foolish Burial, or Fusion Recycling Plant), Special Summons itself with 1000 ATK/DEF; ideal LIGHT material for Duality and Cross-Sheep.
Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
Essential handtrap: negates card effects that add from Deck, Special Summon from Deck, or send to GY.
Effect Veiler
Handtrap & LIGHT Spellcaster Level 1: negates an opponent's face-up monster effect during their Main Phase, and serves as a LIGHT target for Duality into Millennium-Eyes Restrict!
Polymerization
The iconic original Fusion Spell, searchable by King of the Swamp, Keeper of Dragon Magic, and Fusion Recycling Plant; grants targeting protection to Guardian Chimera while in the GY.
Super Polymerization
Unrespondable Quick-Play Fusion Spell that fuses opposing monsters into Mudragon of the Swamp, Garura, Wings of Resonant Life, Starving Venom, or Earth Golem @Ignister.
Fusion Recycling Plant
Field Spell: discards 1 card once per turn to add Polymerization from Deck or GY to hand, and returns 1 Fusion Material from your GY to hand during the End Phase.
Greater Polymerization
Normal Spell: fuses 3+ monsters from hand/field; the summoned Fusion Monster gains piercing battle damage, cannot be destroyed by card effects, and inflicts double piercing battle damage!
Magicalized Fusion
Normal Spell: banishes Fusion Materials from field or GY to Fusion Summon a Spellcaster Fusion Monster (Millennium-Eyes Restrict, Mysterion the Dragon Crown, or Magnum the Reliever).
Duality

Quick-Play Spell: tributes 1 LIGHT or DARK monster to Special Summon 1 monster from hand or Extra Deck with the same Type and Level but opposite Attribute; also banishes from GY to recycle 1 LIGHT + 1 DARK and draw 1 card!
Terraforming
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Fusion Recycling Plant directly from Deck to establish your resource engine immediately.
Foolish Burial
Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Performage Trick Clown to field, or sends a Fusion substitute to GY for recursion.
Forbidden Droplet
Quick-Play Spell: sends cards from hand or field to GY to negate opponent's monsters and halve their ATK without allowing response.
Infinite Impermanence
High-impact handtrap: negates a face-up monster's effects from hand if controlling no cards, plus negates the spell/trap column when Set.
extra: Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon

Supreme Fusion boss: summoned using a Fusion Substitute (King of the Swamp/Versago/Parasite) + a Dragon Effect Monster (Keeper of Dragon Magic/Trishula); cannot be targeted or destroyed by effects, destroys opposing monsters with burn, and discards 1 card to negate any activation with +1000 ATK gain!
Millennium-Eyes Restrict

Level 1 Fusion boss: summoned via Fusion Substitute + 1 Effect Monster, or via Duality tributing Effect Veiler; absorbs opponent's monsters when they activate effects and negates monsters with that name!
Magnum the Reliever

Level 8 Fusion boss (1 monster Summoned from Extra Deck + 1 monster in hand): returns a Polymerization/Fusion Spell from GY to Deck to draw 1 card; Quick Effect banishes a Polymerization/Fusion Spell from GY to destroy 1 card on field!
Guardian Chimera

Level 9 Fusion boss: summoned via Polymerization or Greater Polymerization using 3 monsters with different names; draws cards equal to materials from hand and destroys cards equal to materials from field; untargetable while Polymerization is in GY!
Mysterion the Dragon Crown
Level 8 Spellcaster Fusion boss: summoned via 1 Spellcaster + 1 Dragon; banishes all monsters with the same Type when a monster is Special Summoned by an activated effect.
Garura, Wings of Resonant Life
Level 6 Super Polymerization target (2 monsters with same Type and Attribute but different names): inflicts double battle damage and draws 1 card when sent to GY.
Mudragon of the Swamp
Level 4 Super Polymerization target (2 monsters with same Attribute but different Types): declares an Attribute to grant targeting immunity to all monsters of that Attribute.
Starving Venom Fusion Dragon

Level 8 Super Polymerization target (2 DARK monsters on field): steals an opponent's monster ATK and effect, and destroys all opponent's Special Summoned monsters when destroyed; prime DARK target for Duality into Dragoon!
Earth Golem @Ignister
Level 7 Super Polymerization target (1 Cyberse monster + 1 Link Monster): gains ATK when battling Extra Deck monsters and recycles Cyberse monsters when destroyed.
Trishula, the Dragon of Icy Imprisonment
Level 9 Fusion boss: summoned by banishing 3 monsters with different names from field or hand; banishes cards from opponent's Deck, Extra Deck, and GY; serves as Dragon material for Dragoon.
Cross-Sheep
Link-2 beast: points to a zone where a Fusion Monster is summoned to Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower monster from GY (revives Keeper of Dragon Magic or Trick Clown!) and boost ATK.
Proxy F Magician
Link-2 Cyberse: during your Main Phase, Fusion Summons 1 Fusion Monster using monsters you control as materials without using a Spell, then Special Summons a monster with 1000 or less ATK from hand.
S:P Little Knight
Link-2 staple: banishes a card on field or GY upon Link Summon using an Extra Deck monster, and temporarily banishes itself and another card on field in response to an effect.
